choice.basis: The chart titled 'Decreasing Number of New Tourists in Town Z from 1880 to 1891' shows a line graph of the 'Number of Tourists' on the y-axis against 'Year' on the x-axis. Despite the title, the visual data clearly shows an upward trend, starting at 1,000 in 1880 and ending near 2,900 in 1891, with a peak of 3,300 in 1890. The overall visitor trend is an increase.
